title: Cloud Security Posture Management — baseline attestation
summary: Operator-maintained CSPM baseline that classifies each in-scope cloud resource against a canonical posture policy (NIST 800-53 CM-2 / CM-6 baselines, CIS Benchmarks, provider-published security baselines). Continuous-monitoring deviations are emitted as OCSF Compliance Findings (2003) and consumed by the cloud-misconfiguration playbook's ingest-finding step.

component.title: CSPM baseline service
component.description: Continuous-monitoring service that evaluates cloud resources against the operator's posture baseline and emits compliance findings on deviation.

control-implementations.description: Implements baseline configuration, configuration settings, and component inventory for cloud resources.

implemented-requirements.description: Baseline configuration: operator maintains and reviews the cloud posture baseline.
Configuration settings: deviations from the baseline are detected and reported.
System component inventory: in-scope cloud resources are enumerated and tracked.

sources: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 — CM-2 Baseline Configuration, CM-6 Configuration Settings, CM-8 System Component Inventory
